calls.statement:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT o.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date
  FROM fact_web_order o
),
t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type,
       COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_distinct,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.receipt_id IS NOT NULL) AS n_test,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01') AS n_utc_date
FROM o LEFT JOIN t ON t.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
WHERE o.hel_date = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
                  WHERE f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id AND p.category = 'ZZ Test')
